description: ColGrep pattern benchmark contract — hybrid regex + semantic search evaluation

repos.notes: Well-named functions and classes; grep should do well on many queries

export.description: Export patterns revealing public API surface

structural.description: Structural code patterns (loops, conditionals, error handling)

rg-only.description: Pure ripgrep — no ranking, file:line output
rg-only.notes: Baseline for recall ceiling; no relevance ranking

hybrid-no-regex.description: Sweet Search hybrid mode (BM25 + semantic) without regex
hybrid-no-regex.notes: Shows whether semantic alone finds the right code

pattern-maxsim.description: ColGrep pattern mode — regex candidates + MaxSim ranking
pattern-maxsim.notes: Primary treatment — the feature under test

byRegexFamily.description: Per regex family (class, function, import, etc.)

byNamingQuality.description: Whether the target code uses descriptive names (grep advantage) or abbreviations

grep_match_rate.description: Fraction of queries where regex finds at least one match

indexed_chunk_rate.description: Fraction of grep matches that map to indexed chunks

win_rate_vs_rg.description: Win rate of pattern mode vs rg-only baseline

win_rate_vs_hybrid.description: Win rate of pattern mode vs hybrid-no-regex baseline

queryFormat.description: Each query in queries.jsonl follows this schema

fields.regex: Regex pattern for ripgrep candidate generation
fields.semantic_query: Natural language query for MaxSim ranking
fields.relevant_files: Array of file paths containing the expected results
fields.relevant_chunks: Array of file:startLine-endLine chunk identifiers (gold labels)
fields.language: Programming language of the target code
fields.regex_family: One of: class, function, import, export, config, method, structural, test
fields.notes: Human-readable explanation of what this query tests

exitCriteria.phase0a: Manifest frozen, baseline matrix defined, logging schema locked
exitCriteria.phase1: Harness can run Track A, B1, and C automatically
exitCriteria.phase2_5: Gold labels frozen, failure taxonomy locked, agent-eval rubric locked
exitCriteria.shipGate: All tracks pass, manual audit clean, no systemic judge bias
